mapper.select: SELECT SUM(pay_cash + pay_card + pay_point) ystdsales FROM sale_off S WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND is_old !=1 AND cancel = 0 AND (select replace(datetime ,".","")from sale_off where sale_id = S.sale_id)=#{yesterDay} AND (result='11111' OR result='11110' OR result='11010' OR result='11011' OR result='10010' OR result='10111' OR result='10011')

SELECT SUM(pay_cash + pay_card + pay_point) tsales FROM sale_off S WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND is_old !=1 AND cancel = 0 AND (select replace(datetime ,".","")from sale_off where sale_id = S.sale_id)=#{toDay} AND (result='11111' OR result='11110' OR result='11010' OR result='11011' OR result='10010' OR result='10111' OR result='10011')

SELECT
sale_id ,(select shop_name from shop where shop_id = Z.shop_id)shop_name ,sum(pay_point + pay_card + pay_cash) toDay ,sum(pay_point + pay_card + pay_cash) ystDay FROm sale_off Z
WHERE
is_old !=1 AND cancel = 0 AND (select replace(datetime ,".","")from sale_off where sale_id = Z.sale_id) =#{toDay} AND (result='11111' OR result='11110' OR result='11010' OR result='11011' OR result='10010' OR result='10111' OR result='10011')
group by shop_name order by toDay DESC

SELECT distinct(P.prdct_id) ,(select prdct_name from prdct where prdct_id = P.prdct_id)prdctName ,sum(P.prdct_cnt)prdctCount ,sum(P.prc * P.prdct_cnt)prc
FROM salePrdct_off P, sale_off S WHERE S.shop_id = #{shopId} AND replace(S.datetime,".","")between #{sdate} AND #{edate} AND P.sale_id = S.sale_id AND P.itemTy=#{prdctTy} group by prdctName ORDER BY prdctCount DESC LIMIT 10
